purpose: Freeze the smallest prospective temporal-sensitivity analysis for the already executed F3 CFL020/CFL010 pair. The pair is eligible only for later, separately authorized saved-history analysis under the unchanged count-normalized task; this package does not rerun either solver, retroactively qualify protocol2, or award science credit.

scope_boundary.root_boundary: Both solver executions are historical completed/reaped/parent-paid metadata joins. Protocol4 must be frozen after those executions and before any saved-history/native/HDF5/CSV analysis. Independent review and Root freeze are required before Root authorizes one bounded evaluator; this package authorizes no request, rerun, or control mutation. The actual launch boundary remains DBC default integer1 with no mDBC.

initial_cohort.unresolved_identity_policy: retain in the denominator and label unknown; never replace the denominator with observed or eligible survivors

nearness_bands.predicate: finite current fluid position, y <= 0.08 m, and within the frozen x/z tank envelope
nearness_bands.interpretation: geometric nearness only; never mechanical contact

nearness_bands.predicate: finite current fluid position, y >= 0.32 m, and within the frozen x/z tank envelope
nearness_bands.interpretation: geometric nearness only; never mechanical contact

transverse_return.initial_mean: primary count mean y at accepted t=0 over all 1575 fixed-cohort identities; any missing or invalid identity makes the mean unknown
transverse_return.departure: a saved mean-y state strictly greater than initial_mean_y + 0.02 m
transverse_return.return: the first later saved mean-y state <= initial_mean_y after departure
transverse_return.bracket: adjacent saved timestamps only; no interpolation
transverse_return.mean_policy: At every saved frame, a primary cohort mean is valid only when all 1575 fixed-cohort identities have finite valid y. Missing or invalid identities yield unknown and retain denominator membership; a survivor mean may be diagnostic only and cannot trigger departure or return.

history_contract.window: nominal [0, 6] s for budget purposes, actual same-run saved history from accepted t=0 through the real terminal saved frame
timestamp_requirements: retain every actual saved timestamp and accepted-dt record
t=0 must be represented by the accepted initial frame
terminal must reach the nominal 6 s event; an accepted terminal overshoot is retained and reported
strictly increasing timestamps; duplicates and nonmonotonic values are unavailable/rejected
missing middle states and large gaps remain explicit sampling_gap records
no crop, downsample, interpolation, retiming, fill, or tail drop
history_contract.nominal_slots: 601 is a requested schedule count, never a fabricated measured frame count
history_contract.initial_band_state: initial_present is left-censored and never a t>0 first entry or impact
history_contract.first_entry: first saved in-band state after an observed finite out-of-band predecessor for the same-run identity; report [t[k-1],t[k]] only
history_contract.gap_rule: missing, invalid, unknown, or non-adjacent predecessor yields bracket_unknown/censored, never an inferred entry

residence.unknown_or_missing: retain conservative [0,dt] bounds and explicit unknown count
residence.normalization: divide lower and upper count-time occupancy by 1575

endpoint.identity: initial and terminal frames must belong to the same case and attempt
endpoint.mean_policy: Primary endpoint position and velocity means are defined only when every one of the fixed 1575 initial fluid identities has one finite, valid, same-run endpoint observation. If any identity is missing, invalid, or nonfinite, the primary mean value is null with status unknown; never divide by the eligible survivor count. A separately labelled diagnostic_survivor_mean may be reported for finite observed identities, but it is never a primary metric, decision input, or pass surrogate.

history_contract.cross_run_identity: forbidden; each run is evaluated on its own same-run identities and compared only through aggregate count-normalized observables and explicitly labeled status categories

numerical_control.integrator: Verlet StepAlgorithm=1, 40-step provenance; no fixed-dt substitution

existing_pair_lifecycle.dispatch_boundary: No new control is dispatched by protocol4; the existing CFL020/CFL010 pair is the complete eligible population.

spatial_variant_policy.minimal_gate: No grid or spatial variant is included. The CFL pair is only a temporal-sensitivity screen for the frozen DBC-default spatial setup.
spatial_variant_policy.if_later_required: A dp variant needs a separately reviewed contract and same-run aggregate comparison in common spatial bins or cohort summaries; never match particle IDs across dp.
spatial_variant_policy.credit: The CFL pair cannot award spatial, boundary, general numerical, physical-condition, or core credit; any dp variant needs a separate reviewed gate.

screen_budgets.source: S04/v5 and the adopted SCIENCE_AND_DATA_CONTRACT; these are prospective use screens, not physical error bars

derivation.sensitivity_time: one quarter of the 0.12 s task-time screen
derivation.task_fraction: the SCIENCE contract default 0.05 source-resolution screen, expressed here as a count fraction because this task has a fixed 1575 count denominator
derivation.sensitivity_fraction: one quarter of the 0.05 count-resolution screen
derivation.censor_fraction: one half of the 0.05 count-resolution screen, analogous to the frozen S04/v5 censor screen
derivation.residence_sensitivity: 0.0125 * 6.0 s; a count-fraction screen integrated over the nominal event window

screen_budgets.mass_boundary: No screen above is an operative-mass assertion. Nominal .064 kg and any mass metadata are excluded from this count-normalized gate; any later mass-weighted product requires its own exact native mass contract.
screen_budgets.sampling_boundary: TimeOut=.01 s is a requested save cadence, not a promise about actual accepted dt or gap width. A gap wider than .03 s is retained and makes the affected timing metric unavailable.

g2_comparison.comparison_unit: anchor versus CFL010 aggregate outputs for the same named case; no per-identity cross-run pairing
required_metric_families: endpoint_count_fractions; endpoint means are protective diagnostics

metric_rules.count_fraction: For each endpoint/band/category, compare fixed-1575 fractions. Absolute difference must be <= 0.0125 when both values are fully observed.
metric_rules.endpoint_mean: Primary endpoint count means require all 1575 fixed-cohort identities finite and present in each endpoint. Any missing identity makes the primary mean unknown; never renormalize to survivors. A separately labelled survivor diagnostic is not a G2 decision metric and no spatial or velocity tolerance is defined here.
metric_rules.category_distribution: Use all frozen categories, including initial_present, clean entry, censored entry, never detected, and unknown. Compare normalized total variation; dropping mismatches is forbidden. Require TV <= 0.0125 when the category distribution is complete.
metric_rules.entry_or_return_time: First-entry timing uses the frozen per-run aggregate bracket rule: sort clean adjacent intervals by (lower, upper), pair equal-length lists by rank only, and use d_I=max endpoint separation <= 0.03 s. Ties are exchangeable, empty/unequal lists are explicit statuses, censored/unknown categories stay in the fixed denominator, and no point estimate or interpolation is formed.
metric_rules.residence: For each band compare lower and upper normalized count-time values separately; each endpoint difference must be <= 0.075 s, and each run's censor interval width must be <= 0.025 * 6.0 s.
metric_rules.return_status: A return status is valid only when the fixed-1575 primary mean-y series has no missing/invalid frame required for the departure and return decision. Missing primary means are unknown, not survivor-renormalized. If both returned, compare their adjacent brackets under the 0.03 s screen; this remains a temporal diagnostic.
metric_rules.accepted_dt: The complete traces are required evidence of the control and are reported as distributions; no unregistered maximum-dt tolerance is invented.
metric_rules.temporal_scope: A passing CFL comparison supports temporal sensitivity for this saved-observation use only. It does not close spatial, boundary, reference, holdout, or general numerical qualification.

protective_observations: actual final timestamp and accepted-step overshoot
duplicate, nonmonotonic, missing-middle, and large-gap counts
finite/unknown identity counts at every required endpoint
source/target band status counts and censor bounds
initial-to-terminal mean position and velocity diagnostics
g2_comparison.physical_contact_rule: The .08/.32 results are not contact. Source-plane physical contact at .02/.38 remains unavailable unless its separately frozen emitted-wall convention gate is closed; this scoped G2 protocol does not close it.

scope.spatial_and_boundary_status: not qualified by this CFL pair; remain separate gates

bracket_aggregation.scope: Per-run aggregate first-entry brackets only; no cross-run Idp pairing and no identity-based matching.

record_definition.clean_entry: For one same-run identity, the first adjacent saved pair with finite outside predecessor and finite in-band successor produces [lower_s, upper_s].
record_definition.unknown: Missing, invalid, non-adjacent, or unresolved predecessor is counted in entry_gap_unknown/invalid_or_unknown and never inserted into the clean list.
record_definition.initial_present: An identity already in-band at accepted t=0 is left-censored and never becomes a clean t>0 entry.

bracket_aggregation.within_run_order: Sort clean intervals lexicographically by (lower_s, upper_s). Equal endpoint pairs are tied and exchangeable; no Idp tie-break is used across runs.
aggregate_fields: aggregate_status in {complete, both_empty, availability_mismatch, count_mismatch, invalid, unknown}

between_run_rule.equal_count: When both clean counts are equal and every listed interval has finite ordered endpoints, aggregate_status=complete and pair the j-th sorted interval by rank only; zero equal lists uses both_empty.
between_run_rule.interval_distance: d_I(A_j,B_j) = max(abs(A.lower_s-B.lower_s), abs(A.upper_s-B.upper_s)); require max d_I <= 0.03 s for the timing gate.
between_run_rule.ties: Tied intervals have identical endpoints, so their order cannot change d_I; never resolve ties by cross-run identity.
between_run_rule.both_empty: If both clean lists are empty, aggregate_status=both_empty and the timing gate is complete with zero intervals; category fractions remain required.
between_run_rule.one_empty: If exactly one list is empty, aggregate_status=availability_mismatch and the timing gate is unavailable; do not infer a pass from the empty side.
between_run_rule.count_mismatch: If clean counts differ, aggregate_status=count_mismatch and the timing gate is unavailable; do not truncate to the smaller list.
between_run_rule.censoring: Censored, unknown, initial_present, and never_detected categories remain in the fixed-denominator distribution and are not silently dropped.

bracket_aggregation.unavailable_rule: If aggregate_status is availability_mismatch, count_mismatch, invalid, or unknown, report timing_gate_unavailable and constrain the result to non-timing diagnostics; never claim the full temporal-sensitivity use.

positive_scoped_g2_candidate: both the anchor and CFL010 have exact root-admitted lineage and nonzero successful terminal products
both histories cover accepted t=0 through at least nominal 6.0 s, retain any overshoot, and pass timestamp/accepted-dt/identity integrity
all fixed-cohort primary means required by the task are complete; no survivor mean is substituted
the first-entry aggregate status is complete or both_empty, all category and bracket/residence/return screens are available, and no required timing gap or censor interval exceeds its frozen bound
all count, category, aggregate bracket, residence, and return screens pass exactly as frozen
the result is labelled only F3_saved_count_normalized_nearness_history_temporal_sensitivity_only; it is not spatial, boundary, or general numerical qualification
failed_scoped_g2: both runs are complete enough to make the temporal comparison informative, but any frozen temporal/count screen exceeds its bound
a complete fixed-cohort return status changes between the two controls
a complete category distribution changes beyond the fixed 0.0125 total-variation screen
a complete history reveals a reproducible temporal numerical instability or invalid state under the frozen task
inconclusive_or_unavailable: missing/invalid authority, output, accepted-dt trace, identity join, terminal frame, or source binding
terminal before 6.0 s, nonmonotonic/duplicate timestamps, or unresolved control identity
required censor interval wider than 0.025 or timing gap wider than 0.03 s
return or endpoint primary mean cannot be evaluated over the fixed cohort
CFL010 runtime evidence does not prove a distinct applied numerical control
any primary endpoint or mean-y mean has missing/invalid members of the fixed 1575 cohort
first-entry aggregate status is availability_mismatch, count_mismatch, invalid, or unknown
spatial, boundary, reference, or general numerical evidence is requested from this CFL-only comparison
decision_rules.no_false_pass: A failed or inconclusive metric remains so; do not crop, retime, interpolate, replace the denominator, retry with a changed threshold, or infer a positive result from the anchor alone.

report_only_without_timing_gate.trigger: The count/occupancy/residence metadata may be reportable, but the first-entry aggregate timing gate is unavailable or primary fixed-cohort means are unknown.
